title: Notification ownership and foreground disclosure evidence
minimumPromotionPolicy: Notification promotion requires owned post/cancel/cancelAll evidence, permission denial and settings handoff evidence, foreground disclosure and stop-action behavior for long-running or packaged work, packaged post/cancel evidence, rollback cleanup, and stable denial or explicit promotion decisions for actions, groups, styles, inline replies, listeners, and raw notification objects.

ownershipContract.ownedIdPolicy: provider-owned notification ids are ResourceRegistry backed; cancel only closes active owned records and unknown ids are no-op
ownershipContract.updatePolicy: notify with an existing owned id releases the old record before registering the replacement
ownershipContract.destroyPolicy: provider destroy closes owned notification handles and cancels active records

appliesTo: scheduled/background Node tasks that rely on notification visibility
notification stop action for user-owned cancellation

evidenceMatrix.requiredEvidence: Live provider posts or reports POST_NOTIFICATIONS denial, registers a NOTIFICATION resource, cancel removes it, and provider destroy closes active owned records.
getPermissionStatus and openSettings return JSON-safe permission/status snapshots, with dry-run support for automated tests.
notifications and notifications.settings capabilities reject before bridge dispatch when missing.
Packaged APK post/cancel/cancelAll smoke with package identity ownership, notification permission state, relaunch, task removal, and Safe downgrade evidence.
User-visible disclosure and stop action evidence for packaged or long-running notification-backed Node work.
Explicit stable-denial or promotion decision for actions, groups, styles, inline replies, listener callbacks, RemoteViews, and DND mutation.

requiredArchives.requiredEvidence: Packaged APK post/cancel/cancelAll archive proving package identity ownership, notification permission handling, relaunch, task removal cleanup, and Safe downgrade behavior.
Foreground disclosure and stop-action archive for ongoing packaged notifications and long-running or scheduled Node work.
Android 12 and Android 15+ permission-denied/granted matrix covering POST_NOTIFICATIONS, disabled app notifications, settings round-trip, and denial copy.
Stable-denial or promotion archive for notification actions, groups, styles, inline reply, remote input, listeners, RemoteViews, and DND mutation.
Rollback cleanup archive proving owned notification ids, channels, foreground disclosure metadata, and packaged downgrade behavior are cleaned without touching external notifications.
